question: Singers Sujatha and Ananthu have been awarded the Kalaimamani Award for the year ____________ by the Tamil Nadu Government.
solution:
The correct answer is __2021__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Singers Sujatha and Ananthu have been awarded the Kalaimamani Award for the year 2021 by the Tamil Nadu Government.
 
• The highest state awards that are given yearly to artists for their contribution in their respective fields.
 
• This year popular actors including:
 
• Sivakarthikeyan, Aishwarya Rajesh, Yogi Babu, director Gautham Menon, producers Isari Ganesh and Kalaipuli S Thanu, and editor Anthony have won the award.
